### Welcome to the Discovery Arboretum at Colorado State University!

The Discovery Arboretum is home to over 1,000 trees from more than 800 taxa on a modest two acres. We are a learning laboratory dedicated to people and trees on the main campus of Colorado State University. We are open to everyone on our campus community every day of the year.
